item.name: Ministry for Foreign Affairs of Finland (Ulkoministeriö)
item.description: Finland’s foreign ministry. On 16 November 2026 it reported that the foreign ministers of Finland, Denmark, Estonia, France and Lithuania had asked the EU for stronger action against the use of crypto-assets to evade Russia sanctions.

sources.title: Suomi, Tanska, Viro, Ranska ja Liettua vaativat tehokkaampia toimia Venäjän kryptovaroihin puuttumiseksi
